Post a photo of the tins piling up
Remind everyone about the Christmas drive
Say you're running late for the van

text: Running late for the van, sorry. Off shift at 6 so 18:15 at the earliest
No bother. Who's driving?
Me. Lock up is 7 right
Think so yeah
If nobody wants to wait ill get the bus. Dont want to hold you up
i can wait!! finished my mocks revision for today so im free
Don't get the bus at this hour. Gareth will hang on.
Fine. Not dropping the cage for anyone though
Can someone grab the big box of tins from the store cupboard? The ones for the school sweep
ooh 🙌 what's the school sweep
Parents' hamper thing at the school, we put tins in every year. Nothing dramatic
One of my lot asked me today if he could take the bread from lunch home. Not for him, mum was waiting in the car and they hadn't eaten yet I gave him the rolls in foil
oh sharon
That's hard. Rolls in foil was the right call.
That's awful:( do the school know
They know. It's a long story with the family and I'm not getting into it on here. Just wanted to say it out loud
Ok. Christmas drive list still needs tinned fish and anything with a ring pull. Is the list still on the shared doc
yes its in the drive. i added 2 more kids packs of biscuits
Sharon, I'll put the sweep box in my boot Saturday if you can't get it in.
Thanks frank. Ill bring it to the unit, its by the door
Leaving now 10 mins
Take your time. We're all here.
At the unit. Abigail's already here
yes!! inside, side door is open
[photo: van with the cage packed to the top]
THE CAGE 😭😭😭 we did it
Good work all. Gareth, get the keys back to the vicarage before the caretaker goes.
Keys are with me, dropping them round at 9 on my way home
Sorry I was so late ill do the cage check sat
You weren't late love. Go home and sleep
Sharon, did you get home alright?
Yes just in. Cuppa and bed
is anyone doing sat shift or is it just sorting? rota says me sat am only
Sat 9 to 1 sorting, you and me abigail. Chloe you're on 2 to 6?
Yes 2 to 6 I think. Off shift at 6 tho so bit tired
cant sleep anyone else up
Up with the birds. Walking round the reservoir before it gets cold. Anyone else awake?
still awake lol. chem paper monday and ive read the same page 4 times 😩
Don't come in on no sleep if you're wrecked Abi. Can cover the first hour
no im coming. better than staring at the ceiling 😅
Ok. Kettle's on when you get here
Morning. Sweep box is at the unit by the door so frank don't need the boot
Right you are. Good
at the unit. side door open again 😂
Brilliant. Tins are on the pallet by the back wall, go through the list before you start
[photo: shelves of tinned tomatoes and beans, labelled by row]
tinned fish went on the wrong shelf we fixed it. ring pulls are sorted too
Tell me the ring pulls aren't with the custard
nope!! own shelf
Good. That's us done. Chloe, you've got 2 to 6, cage check is on your list
Got a lie in, finally. Here at 2 😊
Did the school say when they want the box back? Not that it matters
Mon I think. Ask Frank he'll have it in the boot
Don't be cheeky. I'll drop it at the school Monday on my way to the bowls
Thanks Frank 🙏
sorry i'm dead. mocks are going to be a nightmare and mum has started on about christmas eve. told her im on the drive and she's sulking 🙃
Ah. Tell her the drive is the drive. She'll come round
she won't but ok
Cage check done, everything in order. Fridge is 3 degrees. Lock up?
Keys are on the hook in the vestry, Gareth dropped them back Friday. You'll need someone at the vicarage to sign them in
Ok I'll take them round. Anyone want the bus with me
i'm in bed night all
Anyone know if the tinned fish list is final? Got a shop that will do a discount if we ask
Ask Abigail, she's got the doc open
its in the drive. added tinned salmon and 4 more ring pull packs. might be final? ask chloe she did the last count
Yes I'll confirm Monday. Off to bed, tired
Good night all
cant sleep again 🫠
Morning. Shop will do the 10% on the fish if we confirm numbers by Weds. Chloe you're on the count?
[photo: reservoir path, frost on the railings]
Back for lunch. Fingers numb
just woke up slept 4 hrs. mum has stuck a list of christmas eve jobs on the fridge and mine is 'peel potatoes'
Peeling is the worst hope you get out of it love
no chance 😭 will be hiding in the drive
Sorry forgot to say. Keys went back Sat night, verger signed them in. Bus was packed
Good. Count?
Not done it yet. Cage list tmrw after shift. Fish is 14 short so I'd ask for the 10% on the whole order not just the fish
Will ask. Abi can you check the salmon count tonight
Sweep box is still on the unit floor. School office opens 9 Mon so before then Frank if you can
Noted. Bowls is at 10 so I'll go early
doing the salmon count rn. 2 extra tins of salmon in the cupboard that arent on the doc 🤔
Those are from the Tuesday donation. Add them
added!! ok bed now, actually going to try
cant sleep
